memos.scout:
The honest case for buying LIGMA now is weak, and I don't think the brief supports a buy.

Points that could be read as positive: the coin is alive, it has 799 buyers on the curve and 524 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation, the top-3 holder share is low (4.3%), and the classifier tags it ORGANIC with no airdrop dump seen.

But the recent flow contradicts the demand story. In the last 15 minutes, sell SOL (246.2) slightly exceeded buy SOL (238.7), with 484 sellers against 516 buyers, a net outflow of 7.5 SOL and a 29.5% decline. The 30-minute return is -28%, and the price sits 59% below its 30-minute high. The sell-to-buy ratio of 0.92 in the post-graduation window suggests early buyers were already exiting. Half the curve volume is bundled (bundle_share 0.50), and a launch bot was present, which points to manufactured rather than sustained interest. The pool is only 70 SOL deep, so a $20 round trip faces meaningful slippage.

Against a base rate of roughly -20% for random buys in this window, and with momentum still negative, I see no evidence that real demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
